findings.reason: Confirmed against Definition 1.5 p.5, Propositions 2.1/B.2 pp.8,41 and the actual route 5 acceptance text. In A0 x S the Betti map is a torus isomorphism composed with projection to A0; its differential has rank 2 dim(pr1 X). Thus X is non-degenerate exactly when this projection is generically finite onto its image. A constant section has rank zero and A0 x S rank 2g, so both are degenerate for positive-dimensional S. Restrict the every-subvariety test to S a point and the torsion-section test to positive-dimensional S. This argument was re-derived, not adopted from the sibling brief.

Confirmed the unseparated supplier/specialization dependency in item 11 and routes 7/8, checked against pp.23–25. Route 8 names the universal M_g curve owned by route 7, whereas route 7 imports its relative Jacobian from route 8. Split the general relative Picard/Jacobian/degree-one Abel/difference construction over a suitable arbitrary base into the early supplier, and put the M_g-specific level structure and Torelli-square instance in the moduli continuation. Preserve the curve family's smooth, projective, geometrically connected and noetherian-base assumptions when generalizing. A roadmap-level pair of imports is not itself proof of a stage cycle if explicitly separated into early/later layers; the defect here is the briefs' failure to expose that separation. No existing assembled stage cycle is claimed. Coordinate the actual continuation id/title with /9.

Confirmed the false third clause of item 34 against (4.9)–(4.10) p.18 and the Fubini–Study identification p.17. The right-hand side is (L^d.[X]) for the actual represented c1(L), not the fixed O(1,...,1)-degree: the trivial-bundle zero form disproves the latter. The application uses O(0,1,1) and gives (F^d). State X as a possibly singular irreducible subvariety of a smooth projective ambient variety and integrate over its regular locus. Clarify semipositivity/nonnegative integration. Positive in Demailly's convention can include semipositive, as the paper's footnote explicitly explains; that terminology alone is not an independent counterexample.

Confirmed at Mathlib 082e2d3 by reading Module.rank, IsLocalizedModule.rank_eq/finrank_eq, IsLocalization.rank_eq/finrank_eq, isLocalizedModule_iff_isBaseChange, TensorProduct.isBaseChange and Module.rank_eq_zero_iff_isTorsion with their hypotheses. Specialize to Z, Q and localization at nonzero integers. Module.rank Z Gamma equals dim_Q(Q tensor_Z Gamma); finite rank means that cardinal is below aleph0. Under this finiteness hypothesis Module.finrank gives the intended natural number. It does not mean Gamma is finitely generated over Z, and finrank alone is not a test for finiteness (it is zero also at infinite rank). Mark item 5 library, remove its missing-item route and update counts; universe-lift variants are available. No Lean adapter was compiled.
